🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 28, 2026

Moon, in Leo, holds a trine to Neptune, in Aries. Two fire placements agreeing on the terms: what you already own finally finds the words to be counted.

Easier — Agreeing on a figure without feeling robbed by it.
Harder — Agreeing to something because agreeing feels pleasant.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Virgo with no title of its own. Moon in Leo flows toward you — nothing resists, which is the risk. Fire that starts things, started cheaply. The Leo chapter closed four weeks ago.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. Moon squares you from Leo, and the cost objects. Earth that holds on, charged for holding. The same angle for four weeks, and the price has stopped moving.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, holds no rank in Scorpio and simply works. Moon in Leo leaves a door ajar; nothing walks through it alone. Mutable air keeps two accounts, and both balance. Pluto let go of it a week ago.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Mercury trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Cardinal water: beginning costs almost nothing. The hold Venus had a week ago is not there any more.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Sagittarius, untitled. Moon is in your sign now, handling what you own at close range. Fixed fire: what is kept and who keeps it merge. Sun has been out of Scorpio for four weeks now.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, moves through Scorpio unannounced. From Sagittarius, Sun cuts across the appetite. Earth bends, and each bend is invoiced. Forward again for three weeks now, Mercury has left the old ground.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you and holds Libra by right, not by favour. Moon sextiles you from Leo: help that waits to be asked for. Air moves first here, and first is enough. The opposition of a week ago is off it now.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you, untitled in Virgo. Moon in Leo presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Water holds on, and the holding is billed. The sextile to Moon that held three weeks ago has let go.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. From Leo, Moon makes it easy, which is not the same as right. Mutable fire: two answers, and both are affordable. Four weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. From Scorpio, Mercury hands you an opening. Earth begins, and beginning asks little today. New since last week: none of it is habit yet.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon opposes you from Leo, and the account has two columns. Fixed air pays to hold on. Since early November, Saturn has moved 1° and changed nothing.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Mercury in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Water that changes shape, and the shape fits. A week ago Jupiter was still held by Sun; that is finished.
